new_categories.label: ship_communication_endpoint_readiness
new_categories.memory: The ship-side cargo-operation communication endpoint can carry its own readiness state distinct from cargo machinery and protective ESD signaling.

new_categories.label: shore_communication_endpoint_readiness
new_categories.memory: The shore/terminal-side communication endpoint is a separately attributable readiness domain rather than an implied property of the ship endpoint.

new_categories.label: communication_channel_availability
new_categories.memory: A usable ship/shore communication channel can be available, degraded or isolated independently of endpoint hardware readiness without retaining frequency or protocol detail.

new_categories.label: two_way_communication_confidence
new_categories.memory: Two-way communication confidence is distinct from one-way indication or endpoint availability and can be represented without message content.

new_categories.label: acknowledgement_confidence
new_categories.memory: Acknowledgement confidence is a separate coordination state from channel availability and from the correctness of any cargo-operation action.

new_categories.label: communication_independence_confidence
new_categories.memory: Independent or alternate communication confidence can be represented structurally without identifying actual channels, frequencies or prescribed fallback procedures.

new_categories.label: communication_support_dependency_confidence
new_categories.memory: Power, network, interface or other support dependency confidence should remain separate from endpoint and channel readiness.

new_categories.label: terminal_transfer_scope_localization
new_categories.memory: Communication assurance can be localized to a terminal, berth, transfer interface or cargo-operation scope rather than generalized to all vessel communications.

new_categories.label: coordination_confidence_not_action_proof
new_categories.memory: Successful communication or acknowledgement supports coordination confidence but does not prove that a requested or reported physical cargo action occurred correctly.

new_categories.label: communication_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: The service can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, alternate-path, under-verification and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction/isolation can attach separately to ship endpoint, shore endpoint, channel, acknowledgement, support dependency or terminal/transfer scope.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Cargo-operation restriction, coordination concern, terminal incompatibility, rework or schedule effects do not prove an endpoint, channel, acknowledgement or support root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_communication_restoration
new_categories.memory: Endpoint recovery, channel return, two-way confirmation, acknowledgement verification and operational release can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: esd_signal_link_vs_ordinary_communication
useful_refinements.memory: P101 protective shutdown-link assurance is refined by keeping ordinary cargo-operation communication and acknowledgement as a separate service.

useful_refinements.label: digital_control_vs_human_coordination_channel
useful_refinements.memory: P068-style digital/control availability does not establish ship/shore human or operational coordination-channel confidence.

useful_refinements.label: physical_transfer_connection_vs_communication_interface
useful_refinements.memory: P102 physical ship/shore transfer-connection readiness does not imply communication endpoint or channel readiness.

useful_refinements.label: communication_acknowledgement_vs_physical_feedback
useful_refinements.memory: P100 physical valve feedback/indication should not be collapsed with communication acknowledgement of a reported or requested cargo-operation state.

duplicates.label: generic_endpoint_channel_support_lifecycle
duplicates.memory: Generic endpoint/channel/support degradation and restoration mechanics repeat prior service-state families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_verification_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic scope-localization, downstream-effect separation and verified-restoration mechanics are already campaign-wide.

reviewed_no_specific_memory: exact communication equipment, channels, frequencies or network arrangements
exact messages, call signs, phraseology, protocols or acknowledgement wording
exact communication tests, call sequences, fallback methods or cargo-operating procedures
named communication providers, terminals, incidents or current-readiness facts
negative_space: exact ship/shore cargo communication equipment, channel/frequency allocation, network topology, call signs, message content, protocol and current configuration
exact call sequences, phraseology, acknowledgement wording, testing, fallback communication, troubleshooting or cargo-operation procedures
named communication providers, terminals, inspectors, incidents, deficiency findings and current readiness
private/regional communication equipment/service lineages plus non-English predecessor terminology
stop_reason: The bounded structural questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact equipment, frequency, message, protocol, call-sequence, testing, procedure, provider or incident detail that is deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only cargo-operation ship/shore communication-assurance orientation/source-discovery output; not radio, messaging, call-sequence or cargo-operation guidance and not proof of any exact equipment, frequency, message, protocol, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
